array.string: mkdir -p "$HOME/.mate" "$HOME/GoodNotes" { if [ ! -s "$HOME/.mate/rclone_source" ]; then echo "missing rclone source: $HOME/.mate/rclone_source" >&2 exit 1 fi rclone_source=$(/usr/bin/head -n 1 "$HOME/.mate/rclone_source") if [ -z "$rclone_source" ]; then echo "empty rclone source: $HOME/.mate/rclone_source" >&2 exit 1 fi exec "$HOME/.local/bin/mise" exec rclone -- rclone sync \ "$rclone_source" \ "$HOME/GoodNotes" \ --include="**.pdf" \ --create-empty-src-dirs } >>"$HOME/.mate/rclone.stdout.log" \ 2>>"$HOME/.mate/rclone.stderr.log"
